title: Giant raccoons and the toe implant

tellings.quote: uh had some a weird experience uh where uh I saw these giant raccoons in my backyard and uh when I was at the house alone one night

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in people's bodies, says that one night when he was alone at his house in Fillmore, California, he saw giant raccoons in his backyard. He tells it as his own strange experience, tied to an object found in his toe and to the work of a researcher of such implants named Roger Leir. For him it is part of what he takes as a sign of contact.
